Side Effects: Common side effects of this medication may include nausea, vomiting, lightheadedness, dizziness, drowsiness, or constipation. It is important to remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits to you outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. If you are in the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Similarly, in Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before taking this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other opioids (such as codeine or morphine), or to papaverine. Additionally, disclose any other allergies you may have. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. This medication may cause dizziness or drowsiness. Alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate these effects. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you are confident you can do so safely. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages, as this product also contains alcohol. Exercise caution if you have diabetes, liver disease, or any other condition that necessitates limiting or avoiding alcohol in your diet. Women of childbearing age should discuss the risks and benefits of this medication with their doctor before use. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. Use during the first two months of pregnancy may slightly increase the risk of birth defects. Prolonged use or high doses near the expected delivery date may harm the unborn baby. To minimize risk, take the smallest effective dose for the shortest possible duration. This medication passes into breast milk and may have undesirable effects on a nursing infant. Notify your doctor immediately if your baby exhibits unusual sleepiness, difficulty feeding, or trouble breathing. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. The risk of serious side effects, such as slow or shallow breathing and severe drowsiness or dizziness, may increase if this medication is taken with other products that also cause drowsiness or breathing problems. Check the labels of all your medications (e.g., allergy or cough-and-cold products) as they may contain ingredients that cause drowsiness. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Notes: Do not share this medication with others. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
